what: Production construction (h=20, top-10 by |pred|, inverse-vol, raw long/short, 15bp) simulated on four walk-forward panels. Same code, same costs; only the evaluation universe changes.

panels.pitOFF: today's-members convention, no point-in-time mask (the report's original headline)
panels.pitCUR: PIT membership mask, today's code (frozen macro snapshot, 7 factors), repaired membership table
panels.surv: PIT mask + Sharadar histories for all 261 S&P members departed 2014+ (survivorship-complete); prices from the extended panel

reading: Correction 1 (pitOFF -> pitON/pitCUR): the 2026-08-10 PIT experiment compared IC only and found 2022+ untouched; the concentrated top-10 BOOK, however, was riding pre-inclusion run-ups in 2018-2021. Dev Sharpe 0.76 -> 0.35 is membership look-ahead inside the portfolio, not the signal.
Correction 2 (pitCUR -> surv): adding the departed members lowers dev IC by 30% and holdout IC by 27%; the book's all-period Sharpe goes 0.44 -> 0.27.
The honest headline for the production configuration is therefore all-period Sharpe ~0.3 (holdout ~0.85), not 0.8. The 'surv' panel is the evaluation standard from 2026-08-25.
